content: Your message was rejected by the recipient's servers according to so me policy of theirs that we would have no way of knowing. It's certainly automated, and there's probably some broken logic in its algorithm. There is nothing you can do about it except to contact your mail administrator and perhaps that of the recipient, if they will respond.

If there is something in the email header, like, in the subject line, that can distinguish between the tw users, you could then use Message Filters to Tag tag them with colored tags. These articles should give you some ideas:

Organize your messages with filters https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/organize-your-messages-using-filters

Message Tags - Categorize your email in Thunderbird https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/message-tags

You might be able to do something similar on the webmail end, but, of course, that's beyond the scope of Thunderbird and this forum.
